sources: audit/state_park_fees/ne_camping_rates_grid_2025.pdf (row 'Bridgeport SRA NW 308-436-3777', no reservation asterisk, Basic $15 marked only)
summary: Official NGPC pages Cloudflare-blocked (magazine subdomain too), no ReserveAmerica listing (grid shows no reservation asterisk). Grid confirms basic-only, $15 (stored fees already from it) and gives phone 308-436-3777. Imagery: camping is informal, along sandy shore pull-offs of the sandpit lakes with no visible pads; sand-rule candidate. Pin on a grassy peninsula with no visible sites; could not be measured against a site layout. Lakefront stands if the area stays.
flags: PHONE missing: add 308-436-3777 (NGPC 2025 rates grid row 'Bridgeport SRA NW 308-436-3777').

SAND RULE candidate (drop?): on Esri imagery the camping at Bridgeport has no developed loop or pads; the 'designated Basic sites' and ~130 non-designated sites stored in the note line the sand tracks around the five sandpit lakes, and the main shore areas (e.g. the north-shore point at about 41.6806,-103.1092, and the beach strip south of Center Lake at about 41.6770,-103.1095) are open sand flats where a camper drives off the track onto sand at the waterline. NGPC's own magazine headline calls them 'The Beaches of Bridgeport'. I could not read NGPC's description (403), so whether the designated sites are on firm ground could not be confirmed. AWH's call under the 2026-11-04 sand rule.

PIN unmeasured: stored 41.6765,-103.1060 sits on a grassy peninsula between two lakes with no visible pads or vehicles (leaf-off imagery); without a site map there is no centroid to measure against. If the entry stays, NGPC's park map (outdoornebraska.gov, blocked here) would place it.
SPLIT: none found; the camping is one dispersed area around connected lakes on a single entrance off the US-26/NE-92 bridge road.
WATERFRONT lakefront stands for the shore camping (sites at the waterline on open sand), but only if the entry survives the sand rule.
